rec.name: Manually Configurable Scarcity Message

what.text: A scarcity message (e.g. 'Only X left') whose wording and value the merchant sets manually, instead of it being pulled automatically from real inventory. The ticket is a single line ('Set scarcity yourself') with no UI, placement or format details.

why.text: Scarcity raises perceived value and loss aversion, which pushes buyers to decide sooner. Manual control lets the team run the message on products where inventory data is unreliable or hidden, and test different wording and thresholds. Caveat: manual values that don't reflect real stock can erode trust, so they should be used honestly.

how.text: Likely a PDP block with theme-editor settings (enable toggle, message text, number) and optionally a per-product metafield override. Render the text and an optional progress bar near the price or add-to-cart button. The ticket does not confirm any of this implementation.

items: Manually entered stock number or threshold

dependencies.text: Not stated in the ticket. Probably a product metafield for per-product values, or only theme-editor block settings if the message is global.

items: Conversion rate on products with the message
